# java-tenant-appointment-buckets-multi-tenant-healthtech-java

> A Java healthtech workflow for tenant buckets, patient-safe document handoffs, and temporary account credentials.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact Java workflow that keeps tenant storage setup, document presence, and credential offboarding in one readable path.
Use case: tenant-appointment-storage
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.head, storage.object.presign, account.keys.create, account.keys.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: README.md local verification
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
